title: Watersound "Coastal Reflections" 42 Founders Court
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Private Heated Pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for $30 per day**- Gulf Views- 4 Passenger Golf Cart- Outdoor Living Area- 6 Adult Bikes- Grill- Garage- Fireplace- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Nestled in the coveted WaterSound community, Coastal Reflections is a thoughtfully designed home that hosts up to 14 guests, with 6 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, and 2 half baths. Luxuriate in sun-kissed days by the private pool, barbecues in the Summer kitchen, and evening drinks admiring the Gulf from the lookout tower. With the beach boardwalk and The Big Chill’s family-friendly entertainment only a short stroll away, guests are perfectly located for fun on the Emerald Coast!Lush landscaping and a furnished front porch made for laid-back mornings greet guests upon arrival. Inside, a classic foyer leads into the sprawling great room, where warm wood beams, coastal-inspired décor, and a neutral palette curate a serene setting. A plush wraparound couch and matching armchairs invite guests to unwind before the TV and fireplace. In the center of the room, an elegant dining table seats 10 for meals or merry game nights. The expansive kitchen is a chef’s dream, featuring top-of-the-line appliances, a vast center island that seats 3, and a neighboring wet bar for entertaining. Along the wall, accordion doors open to a screened patio with a Summer kitchen and outdoor fireplace where guests can enjoy the balmy Florida air. Continue outside to find a beautiful pool surrounded by comfy seating and flourishing greenery. When bedtime arrives, a gorgeous, window-lined guest bedroom offers a king bed and private bathroom.The second level features a lovely living space with soft seating and a TV, multiple sleeping accommodations, and a spacious laundry room. Rest easy in the primary bedroom and first guest bedroom, each featuring an inviting king bed and private bathroom. The other guest bedroom has a queen bed, and the kid-friendly bunk room features 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds.On the third floor, discover a convenient wet bar beside doors to the spacious, covered deck, a dedicated office space, and a charming guest bedroom with 2 full beds.A staircase from the third-floor deck takes guests up to the lookout tower to enjoy stunning Gulf views.Coastal Reflections has everything guests need for a wonderful WaterSound vacation, including 3 designated parking spaces, a low-speed vehicle for 4, and 6 complimentary adult bikes to explore 30A. For designated beach access, follow Founders Court to St. Croix Court, turn right onto WaterSound Way, and follow the boardwalk at the end of the road. Book today! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Jack and Jill Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Jack and Jill Bathroom With Shower Only- Additional Living Area: Common Area with TV and Couch THIRD FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: 2 Full Beds, Half Bathroom and Mini Fridge and Wet BarFOURTH FLOOR:- Patio with Gulf Views *Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watch Video Watersound "Coastal Reflections" 42 Founders Court Watersound, Florida Bedrooms 6 Beds 10 Sleeps 14 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 2 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gated Community with on-site Security - Private Heated Pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for $30 per day** - Gulf Views - 4 Passenger Golf Cart - Outdoor Living Area - 6 Adult Bikes - Grill - Garage - Fireplace - From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella) - Private Deeded Beach Access - Free WiFi - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout This property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate. DETAILS: Nestled in the coveted WaterSound community, Coastal Reflections is a thoughtfully designed home that hosts up to 14 guests, with 6 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, and 2 half baths. Luxuriate in sun-kissed days by the private pool, barbecues in the Summer kitchen, and evening drinks admiring the Gulf from the lookout tower. With the beach boardwalk and The Big Chill’s family-friendly entertainment only a short stroll away, guests are perfectly located for fun on the Emerald Coast! Lush landscaping and a furnished front porch made for laid-back mornings greet guests upon arrival. Inside, a classic foyer leads into the sprawling great room, where warm wood beams, coastal-inspired décor, and a neutral palette curate a serene setting. A plush wraparound couch and matching armchairs invite guests to unwind before the TV and fireplace. In the center of the room, an elegant dining table seats 10 for meals or merry game nights. The expansive kitchen is a chef’s dream, featuring top-of-the-line appliances, a vast center island that seats 3, and a neighboring wet bar for entertaining. Along the wall, accordion doors open to a screened patio with a Summer kitchen and outdoor fireplace where guests can enjoy the balmy Florida air. Continue outside to find a beautiful pool surrounded by comfy seating and flourishing greenery. When bedtime arrives, a gorgeous, window-lined guest bedroom offers a king bed and private bathroom. The second level features a lovely living space with soft seating and a TV, multiple sleeping accommodations, and a spacious laundry room. Rest easy in the primary bedroom and first guest bedroom, each featuring an inviting king bed and private bathroom. The other guest bedroom has a queen bed, and the kid-friendly bunk room features 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds. On the third floor, discover a convenient wet bar beside doors to the spacious, covered deck, a dedicated office space, and a charming guest bedroom with 2 full beds. A staircase from the third-floor deck takes guests up to the lookout tower to enjoy stunning Gulf views. Coastal Reflections has everything guests need for a wonderful WaterSound vacation, including 3 designated parking spaces, a low-speed vehicle for 4, and 6 complimentary adult bikes to explore 30A. For designated beach access, follow Founders Court to St. Croix Court, turn right onto WaterSound Way, and follow the boardwalk at the end of the road. Book today!
